fields.name: placed
fields.description: Ordered list of the colors of the cubes that have been put into the bin so far, one entry per completed 'put it into the bin' subgoal, oldest first. The literal empty list [] at step #1, written explicitly and never left blank; at every later step the field is again an explicit list. At the decision step that directly follows an execution of B (the execution steps show a cube held in the gripper and then released over the bin, and the scene at the decision step shows the gripper open with nothing held), append the color of the cube that was held during that execution. Never append after a pick-up execution (one that ends with a cube held) and never after pressing the button. Count released cubes even if a cube of that color later appears somewhere on the table, since the bin is opaque and detections near it are unreliable. e.g. ["green", "green"]

fields.name: cubes
fields.description: Ordered list of the cubes of the goal colors that are on the table and not yet picked, oldest first, each entry as [color, [y, x]] with the position as last seen. Age on the table is what the list preserves: a cube present at the start of the episode precedes every cube that appeared during execution, and among cubes that appeared during execution the earlier arrival precedes the later. At step #1 fill it with every visible cube of a goal color, ordered by distance to the bin's center, nearest first (ties: smaller y). At every later step copy the carried list, then (a) remove the entry of the cube that the execution steps show being closed on and lifted in the gripper, (b) append, in order of first appearance, every cube of a goal color that first appears during the execution steps at a place where no entry already lies (two detections within about 10 px are the same cube; a cube briefly not reported because the arm covers it keeps its entry; a detection reported only while a cube is held, or at the bin's position, is not a cube), and (c) refresh each remaining entry's position to its latest reported position. Cubes of colors the goal does not name are never entered. Write it as a JSON array with double-quoted color strings. e.g. [["blue", [54, 118]], ["blue", [87, 181]], ["blue", [53, 102]]]
